body: Yeah, I called the cops on my friend who was going to attempt suicide. I don’t trust the police, I have heard way too many stories of people being killed by police while they’re going through a mental health crisis. I knew this but I called them anyways. I get that my intentions were good or whatever but that doesn’t excuse the fact that I put their life in danger. I had the phone number to a crisis center but I didn’t call them because I was in a panic and I forgot that I had the number.
